headline: Analysts recommend Brooks Laboratories and Deepa Jewellers amid market weakness
hook: Technical picks during a market sell-off
summary: Indian equities faced ongoing selling pressure driven by a hawkish RBI stance, foreign institutional investor outflows, rising bond yields, and a weak rupee. Despite the broader market downturn, technical analysts have highlighted Brooks Laboratories and Deepa Jewellers as potential medium-term opportunities following bullish chart breakouts. Retail investors navigating the current sell-off should assess whether these technical setups align with their risk tolerance before taking positions.
why_it_matters: Two retail stock ideas emerge amid ongoing market weakness.
